newsitem.title: UK: MAM at record in buoyant fund sector.
newsitem.headline: MAM at record in buoyant fund sector.

text.p: Shares in Mercury Asset Management Plc and other fund management groups were squeezed higher on Thursday on continued bid talk and in reflection of strong financial markets, dealers said.
"The sector is in vogue," said one market maker, "bid stories are doing the rounds and they are not very liquid stocks."
He said there was talk of a bid for MAM from HSBC Holdings Plc, up 20p at 15.91-1/2. "They are big enough and they have got the money," he said.
MAM was up 31-1/2p at after reaching record 14.20 stg, passing the previous peak of 14.15 stg set on February 10. Volume reached 1.1 million shares.

Other fund managers also rose with Perpetual Plc up 105p at 27.57-1/2 in volume of just 2,000 shares, M&G Group Plc up 30p at 14.32-1/2 stg and Henderson up 25p at 13.52-1/2. Close Brothers was up 10-1/2p at 420.

Fund managers, whose earnings reflect strength in financial markets, also reflected gains in equities on both sides of the Atlantic. In the wake of strong gains on Wall Street on Wednesday, the FTSE 100 leapt to a record 4,396.2.
